## Create your workspace

Open the address printed by `shinbot start`. A local first start includes the installation token in the setup link. If Home asks for it, run `shinbot setup-token` on the host and paste the result.

Choose a password with at least 12 characters. You can reveal it while typing. Starter templates are optional; a selected template appears beside the setup form and can be removed before creating the workspace.

Setup suggests your browser’s timezone. Keep it or choose another; change it later in **Settings → Workspace**.

## Connect a model

Choose **Connect your model** on Home. You can provide an API key, use a supported subscription sign-in, or connect a local or OpenAI-compatible endpoint. [Model connections](03-models.qmd) explains the options.

Once a model is connected, choose **Start chatting**. **Help me get started** sends a request to the selected model to help you choose a first task. That action uses your provider's allowance.

## Try a small task

Start with a task you can check:

> Help me plan tomorrow. Ask about my commitments first, then write a short plan in a note.

Or try a browser task:

> Open the project website and find its installation instructions. Tell me what you found before downloading anything.

When ShinBot asks for approval, read the action and its arguments. Use Computer to watch a website, take over a step, and hand control back.

## Make the workspace comfortable

Open **Settings → Appearance** to choose System, Light or Dark. System is the default and follows the device setting. The choice is saved in this browser and applies immediately. Appearance is also available before sign-in.

Use the sidebar to switch between bots and recent chats. Press **Cmd K** on macOS or **Ctrl K** on Linux to search the workspace. Message drafts stay with their bot or conversation when you switch pages.
